card: B's step (BP 2C00h / DX 2400h) vs V4's 2800h/2000h (32 positions) vs other full-coverage steps

model.what: A005 partner-crossfire model with B's BP as a parameter (arg 8). A killed by B summed over 18 startup-delay settings x 25 band combos (450 runs): 2C00h 197, 2800h 220, 2400h 111, 5400h 87, 0C00h 48. Crossfire is only ~1-2% of deaths (A005), so this was not used to choose candidates.

v4Note: V4's step (2800h) was not re-screened: holdout 5 already measured V4 at about -0.033 vs V6 in the pooled field (V6nohunt-V4 +0.0416, V6nohunt-V6 +0.0082), with V4 ahead only in the zchain4-present group. Source: agent2/NOTES.md.

candidates.label: s24

crossScreenPattern: All three other steps give the same direction in each cohort. Mean of the 3 diffs per cohort: 2025 -0.020 (se 0.018), strong +0.068 (se 0.044; sstrong-1 [b01d, e1p4, HLS_segment_fault] +0.31 in all three), threat +0.017, multi -0.083 (se 0.019), ALL +0.0015. Steady per-cohort effects in all three: s2025-25 (GoldenLamed/InCtrl/SKYENT) -0.27, movsw_TrojanByte -0.19, movsw_BinaryBandits -0.23, cgx123123 +0.24, lead_V4 +0.16, lead_zrl03 +0.13. This is a trade-off: 2C00h is good on the 2025 field and against MOVSW crowds, and other steps are better against the strong/peer field. Changing the step makes screens about 4x noisier (ALL SE ~0.018) than 1-turn edits.

threatFindings.threat: V4's 32-position step (2800h) is worse than V6's 2C00h overall
threatFindings.evidence: holdout 5 (agent2/NOTES.md): V6nohunt - V4 +0.0416 [+0.027,+0.056] pooled vs V6nohunt - V6 +0.0082; V4 ahead only when zchain4 is present (-0.046). Not re-screened.

threatFindings.threat: Other full-coverage B steps lose in multi-copy V6-family cohorts (screen multi -0.065 to -0.117)
threatFindings.evidence: threat k145x (s34, 3 copies, 24 cohorts x 20): lead_V6 +0.028, lead_V6Guard +0.032, lead_V4 +0.017, lead_zchain4 +0.035, ALL +0.028 [-0.008,+0.064]. The screen multi group has only 2 cohorts; smulti-mix was not tested separately.

threatFindings.threat: Step 2C00h is specifically exploited by strong/peer field opponents (b01d/e1p4 cohort sstrong-1) and by zrl03/ah02/V4
threatFindings.evidence: Same positive sign in all 3 screens (sstrong-1 +0.27..+0.35, lead_zrl03 +0.07..+0.21, lead_V4 +0.05..+0.24), but each cohort has only 30 battles with one seed. Not traced.

threatFindings.threat: B's 800h trail kills A (partner crossfire) at a rate that depends on step
threatFindings.evidence: Model only (phase-sim.mjs): 2C00h 197/450 vs 0C00h 48/450. A005 measured crossfire at ~1-2% of deaths, so at most ~0.004 is at stake.

recommendation: Do not promote any step variant. None reaches ALL >= +0.006 with no negative group: all lose about 0.02 on the 2025 field and gain about 0.07 on the strong field. If the coordinator values the strong/peer field more, s34 (best ALL +0.0054, threat +0.032, V6-family 3-copy stress +0.028) or sD4 (strong +0.090 [0.021,0.158], 6/0) could get a confirmation run. A step choice per field cannot be made from one screen because step changes are noisy. V4's 2800h is already known to be worse (holdout 5).
